all.source_quote: Priority to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households as identified through official socio- economic surveys

unmodelled.text: Household must be rural and without an existing Individual Household Latrine
unmodelled.source_quote: Rural household without an Individual Household Latrine

unmodelled.text: If not BPL, household must be an Above Poverty Line (APL) household belonging to vulnerable categories such as SC/ST, small and marginal farmers, landless laborers, or physically challenged persons
unmodelled.source_quote: Identified Above Poverty Line (APL) households belonging to vulnerable categories such as SC/ST, small and marginal farmers, landless laborers, and physically challenged persons

unmodelled.text: Resident of a rural area covered under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen)
unmodelled.source_quote: Must be a resident of a rural area covered under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen)

ambiguous: The term "vulnerable categories" includes social groups and occupations that cannot be precisely captured with the available fields.
